provenance: Independently authored synthetic project history; all people, project details and URIs are fictional. URIs are attribution labels, not fetch targets.

documents.author: Mira (synthetic)
documents.text: The desktop editor writes an unsent change to an on-disk outbox before acknowledging Save. A power failure cannot erase an acknowledged edit.

documents.author: Dev (synthetic)
documents.text: A second submission carrying the same request nonce returns the original receipt. The server does not apply the edit twice.

documents.author: Lena (synthetic)
documents.text: The installer stages a replacement in a sibling directory, then renames the directory after checksum verification. A failed checksum leaves the running installation untouched.

documents.author: Omar (synthetic)
documents.text: Every audit record includes the initiating account and the UTC timestamp. Audit records omit the document body to avoid copying confidential content.

documents.author: Mira (synthetic)
documents.text: An expired login opens the editor in read-only mode. Local drafts remain visible, but publishing waits for renewed authentication.

documents.author: Dev (synthetic)
documents.text: The importer decodes the complete UTF-8 file before starting its transaction. Malformed encoding rejects the entire import, so no partial rows are committed.

documents.author: Lena (synthetic)
documents.text: We chose SQLite for the desktop catalog rather than a remote database. Offline operation and a single backup file matter more than simultaneous writers.

documents.author: Omar (synthetic)
documents.text: We chose pull-based refresh instead of push notifications for the report viewer. Restricted office networks block persistent inbound connections; periodic outbound requests work there.

documents.author: Mira (synthetic)
documents.text: We retained whole paragraphs in the incident export instead of clipping sentences. Reviewers need the condition beside the instruction; a clipped instruction can reverse the procedure.

documents.author: Dev (synthetic)
documents.text: We disabled unattended schema upgrades in the portable reader. An operator must first verify a backup because older readers cannot open the new format.

documents.author: Lena (synthetic)
documents.text: The catalog backup procedure closes the writer before copying the database file. This closure prevents a backup from omitting changes still held in the write-ahead log.

documents.author: Omar (synthetic)
documents.text: The catalog restore procedure verifies the copied file checksum before replacing the live file. Restore never copies a file whose checksum differs from the recorded backup digest.

documents.author: Mira (synthetic)
documents.text: The report export route accepts at most 200 records in a request. Larger jobs must be split into successive requests.

documents.author: Dev (synthetic)
documents.text: The report export client continues from the returned cursor, not from a computed page number. The cursor preserves ordering when new reports arrive.

documents.author: Lena (synthetic)
documents.text: The queue worker refuses a job older than six hours. Expired jobs are recorded as skipped rather than executed.

documents.author: Omar (synthetic)
documents.text: The queue dashboard displays skipped jobs in amber. This display rule applies to the expiration behavior defined for the queue worker, not to failed jobs.

documents.author: Mira (synthetic)
documents.text: The attachment uploader verifies the full content digest before publishing a link. Digest verification is the publication gate for attachments.

documents.author: Dev (synthetic)
documents.text: The attachment uploader keeps a rejected payload for two days for local diagnosis. This retention rule covers payloads rejected by the attachment digest publication gate.

documents.author: Lena (synthetic)
documents.text:
The delivery retry window is 30 minutes after the first failure. Attempts stop when that window expires.

The deployment rehearsal is scheduled for Tuesday. The release crew must attend before the production change.

documents.author: Omar (synthetic)
documents.text: The mobile preview experiment offers offline map downloads. This is an experimental proposal, not a shipped capability.

documents.author: Mira (synthetic)
documents.text: The billing service retry window is 90 minutes. Billing retries are unrelated to delivery failures.

documents.author: Dev (synthetic)
documents.text: The training rehearsal happens every Tuesday. It does not set the deployment rehearsal schedule.

documents.author: Lena (synthetic)
documents.text: The desktop preview cache stores rendered charts for offline viewing. It contains no map downloads.

documents.author: Omar (synthetic)
documents.text: A checksum on the installer archive verifies transfer integrity. It does not authenticate the publisher; signature verification is a separate release task.

documents.author: Mira (synthetic)
documents.text: The laboratory queue executes expired simulation jobs for comparison. Laboratory behavior does not govern the production queue worker.

documents.author: Dev (synthetic)
documents.text: The report viewer refresh interval is five minutes. This interval is unrelated to delivery retry deadlines.

documents.author: Lena (synthetic)
documents.text: An administrative account can rotate the audit log. Rotation preserves the old log file and does not change audit record contents.

documents.author: Omar (synthetic)
documents.text: The importer writes rejected filenames to its diagnostic log. The diagnostic log does not contain imported rows or document bodies.

changes.text:
Correction: the delivery retry window is 10 minutes after the first failure, replacing the earlier 30-minute setting. Attempts stop when that window expires.

Correction: the deployment rehearsal is scheduled for Thursday, replacing the earlier Tuesday schedule. The release crew must attend before the production change.
